items.label: Small Light Motorcycle (<50cc / Green Plate)
items.value: Max speed 45 km/h on regular roads

items.label: Regular Heavy Motorcycle (50cc–249cc / White Plate)
items.value: Max speed 50 km/h (urban), 40 km/h (narrow/slow lane); No freeway access

items.label: Large Heavy Motorcycle (250cc–549cc / Yellow Plate)
items.value: Follows small car rules; Permitted on designated expressways, NO freeways

items.label: Super Heavy Motorcycle (550cc+ / Red Plate)
items.value: Follows small car rules; Permitted on expressways & designated national freeways

items.label: Two-Stage Left Turn (Hook Turn / 兩段式左轉)
items.value: Mandatory when hook turn sign is posted OR on roads with 3+ lanes / 'No Moto' inner lane

items.label: Inner Lane 'No Motorcycle' (禁行機車) Marking
items.value: Strictly prohibited from riding or overtaking in inner lane when marked

items.label: Minimum Tire Tread Depth (Motorcycle)
items.value: 0.8 mm (check wear indicator bar on tire shoulder)

items.label: Motorcycle Helmet Standard & Fastening
items.value: Must wear approved CNS safety helmet firmly strapped; NT$500 fine for violation

items.label: Pillion Passenger Seating Rule
items.value: Must sit astride on rear seat facing forward; Strictly 1 passenger on heavy moto

items.label: Carrying Children on Footrest Area
items.value: Strictly PROHIBITED to place children/babies on front pedal/footrest

items.label: Motorcycle Cargo Weight Limit
items.value: Heavy moto: max 80 kg; Light moto: max 50 kg

items.label: Motorcycle Cargo Dimensions
items.value: Height: max shoulder height; Width: max handlebar width + 15cm per side; Length: max 50cm past rear

items.label: Administrative Fine BAC Threshold
items.value: 0.15 mg/L breath alcohol (or 0.03% blood alcohol)

items.label: First-Time Motorcycle DUI Fine
items.value: NT$15,000 to NT$90,000 + License suspension for 1 to 2 years

items.label: Refusing Breathalyzer Sobriety Test
items.value: NT$180,000 fine + Instant license revocation + Vehicle impoundment

items.label: Operating Mobile Phone While Riding
items.value: NT$1,000 fine (strictly prohibited while riding)

items.label: Accumulating 12 Demerit Points within 1 Year
items.value: Driver license suspended for 2 months

items.label: Intersection Right-of-Way Priority #1
items.value: Straight-going vehicle has absolute priority over turning vehicle

items.label: Intersection Right-of-Way Priority #2
items.value: Left-turning vehicle MUST yield to Right-turning vehicle

items.label: Uncontrolled / Equal Intersections
items.value: Vehicle on left must yield to vehicle approaching from RIGHT side

items.label: Roundabout Traffic Right-of-Way
items.value: Vehicles entering roundabout MUST yield to vehicles already circulating inside

items.label: Left Arm Extended Horizontally, Palm Downward
items.value: Indicates Left Turn (or lane change to left)

items.label: Left Upper Arm Horizontal, Forearm Upward
items.value: Indicates Right Turn (or lane change to right)

items.label: Left Arm Extended Downward, Palm Backward
items.value: Indicates Slowing Down or Stopping

items.label: Passing Stopped Public Bus at Bus Stop
items.value: Slow down, maintain safe buffer, expect hidden pedestrians stepping out from front of bus

items.label: Entering / Exiting Tunnel Glare Hazard
items.value: Turn on low-beam headlights, decelerate, expect brief visual adaptation delay

items.label: Wet Road Surface & Manhole Covers / Road Paint
items.value: Avoid hard braking or sharp leaning on painted road markings and metal covers

items.label: Large Vehicle Turning Blind Spots & Off-Tracking
items.value: Stay clear of inner rear wheel path of turning large trucks/buses

items.label: Car Doors Opening Suddenly (Dooring Risk)
items.value: Maintain at least 1 meter buffer from parked cars along roadside
